# Case-insensitive names and phrases that must not appear in a commit
# message, a pull request title, or a pull request description. Checked by
# .github/workflows/tool-attribution-check.yml, which looks only at the
# commits new to a pull request and at that pull request's own title and
# body, never at history already on main.
#
# This file is the single place to add or remove a term; the check script
# (.github/scripts/check_tool_attribution.py) reads it and does not keep
# its own copy of the list.
#
# Scope: every entry below is a fixed name or phrase (an AI coding tool, an
# AI vendor, or a project-specific phrase such as "explainers"). This file
# does not, and cannot, cover this project's other posting rules -- review
# round counts, account IDs, ARNs, private IPs, or internal cluster names --
# because those are shaped values, not fixed strings a denylist can name.
# Checking for those stays a human step before posting (CONTRIBUTING.md).

Anthropic
Fable
Opus
Sonnet
Haiku
